job.title: Sr. Engineer - Data Analytics
job.description:
Silver Mesa Resorts operates hotels and casinos. The data analytics team builds the platform behind guest, gaming and revenue reporting.

Responsibilities: design end-to-end cloud data architecture from ingestion to reporting; operate Kafka and Airflow; own data quality and governance practices.

Requirements: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or similar; 5+ years as a data engineer on cloud platforms; SQL and Python.

On site at our Austin property.
